title: Australia Adds 39.5k Jobs, but Rising Unemployment Reveals a Softer Undercurrent
summary: Australian employment rebounded from -15.8k to +39.5k in August, comfortably beating expectations for a gain of around 20k, but the stronger headline was offset by a rise in unemployment. The unemployment rate increased from 4.5% to 4.6%, while the participation rate climbed from 66.9% to 67.1%. title: Japan Growth Slips a Gear While Weak Yen Keeps Inflation Pressure Elevated
summary: Japan’s private-sector growth slowed in September, with PMI Manufacturing easing from 54.9 to 54.1, PMI Services from 52.5 to 51.6, and PMI Composite from 53.5 to 52.5. Manufacturing output also moderated from 56.1 to 54.9. title: Australian Dollar declines against Japanese Yen following mixed jobs data
summary: AUD/JPY extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 110.80 during Asian hours on Thursday. The currency cross continues to trade under pressure as the Australian Dollar (AUD) remains subdued following the release of the latest domestic labor market data.
